variants.description: Correct implementation. A gate that blocks this is a false positive.
The API base controller no longer requires a token, so every /api/v1 endpoint is publicly readable. No test asserts on unauthenticated access.
The server-side page cap is inverted: ?per_page=100000 now returns 100000 rows, and the default request returns 100 instead of 25. The suite only exercises the default path with no per_page param.
show raises NoMethodError on nil for any project with a null description. The fixture used by the test happens to have one set.
The response no longer carries pagination state, which PLAN.md lists as an explicit acceptance criterion. The test that asserted it was removed along with it, so the suite is green.
The show endpoint has no test at all. Nothing fails; the endpoint is simply unverified.
